review.tagline: Permission-aware search and agent context over Slack, Drive, GitHub and more
review.summary: PipesHub indexes content from 50+ business systems such as Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Microsoft 365 and Notion, then answers questions with block-level citations filtered by each user's source-system permissions. It stores data in a Neo4j or ArangoDB graph, Qdrant vectors and MongoDB, and exposes the same context to agents through a no-code builder, an MCP server and Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs. Any LLM provider works, including local models via Ollama.
review.audience: Teams self-hosting permission-aware company search and agent context
strengths: Answers cite specific blocks in source documents and respect per-user source permissions
50+ connectors with real-time and scheduled indexing
Exposes context via an MCP server and Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs
Interactive installer generates secrets and .env; Kubernetes with HA defaults supported
weaknesses: Multi-service stack: Neo4j or ArangoDB, Qdrant, MongoDB, Redis, optionally Kafka
Audio and video are stored but not indexed yet
Hosted PipesHub Cloud is only a waitlist; self-hosting is the only option today
Personalized search and PageRank-augmented relevance are not yet shipped
needs: Needs Docker Compose v2, Neo4j or ArangoDB, Qdrant, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka (larger deployments)
Models: Any LLM provider, Ollama local models, Local embedding server by default
